method: Authenticated Google Search Console UI; one click on Request indexing, after completed production verification
timestampMeaning: requestedAt is the local UTC clock immediately before the single UI submission; observedAt records the confirmed success dialog. Google does not expose its exact enqueue timestamp here.
resultMeaning: URL added to priority crawl queue; repeated submission does not improve queue position or priority
preRequestGoogleState: URL is unknown to Google; no recorded crawl
nextAction: Read-only crawl/indexation watch; do not resubmit
